title: Nvidia shares closed down 14% on Friday, sliding for a seventh straight day; the stock fell 44% over seven weeks, pushing the company's market cap down by $2.5T (Kif Leswing/CNBC)
summary: Kif Leswing / CNBC: Nvidia shares closed down 14% on Friday, sliding for a seventh straight day; the stock fell 44% over seven weeks, pushing the company's market cap down by $2.5T — The last time Wall Street was this down on Nvidia the chipmaker's flagship product was the GeForce graphics processor …
